column1: # Graveyard Keeper 2 (Unity 6000.3.9f1 IL2CPP with FMOD on SDK 21.4.4, update 1.0.4). Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py);
# checked by hand against the survey on 2026-10-26: the modules (subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library; sdk and subsdk0 are Viractal's builds), the 5 GB guest layout of a game
# that maps its own memory with no heap (as Viractal and Hollow Knight: Silksong), the 16 MB system resource from the NPDM; on Android it plays with these keys
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# Unity's free memory (main+0xcaf2d0) is GetInfo's total less used non-system memory, and its maps grow in steps as play goes on (about 16 MB a minute over the first 30 minutes):
# the used memory counts the alias region's mapped pages and the pool is enforced, as on Horizon (hle_svc.c). With it (and the node area cut on its sdk build, sdk_patches.py)
# a 1 h 54 min session mapped at most 2.44 GB of the 3.21 GB pool and no map was refused
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the host writes Unity's vsync count and frame time in game memory (hle_fpslock.c). The game still asks for present interval 2, which
# present_interval display ignores; both are needed (with the writes alone, frames stayed at 33.3 ms)
